scripts.test:qa: npm run test:load && npm run test:stress && npm run test:volume && npm run test:security
scripts.docker:build: docker compose -f server/compose.yaml build && docker compose -f client/compose.yaml build
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f server/compose.yaml up -d && docker compose -f client/compose.yaml up -d && docker compose -f monitoring/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f client/compose.yaml down && docker compose -f server/compose.yaml down && docker compose -f monitoring/compose.yaml down
